plain_summary: This page details the "Light Dues" tariff under SECTION 1. It reiterates the definition of a vessel's gross tonnage for tariff purposes and defines South African territorial waters (12 nautical miles). It then specifies two main categories for light dues: self-propelled/licensed vessels pay R24.64 per metre of length overall per financial year. "All other vessels" are subject to conditions regarding staying within South African waters and a 60-day time limit. If a vessel exceeds 60 days, it's deemed coastal and liable for light dues on a per calendar month basis, with a rate of R117.08 per 100 tons or part thereof. Special provisions for "Bonafide Coasters" are also outlined, including monthly charges and full light dues if returning from a foreign port.
